title: Datverb
excerpt: Datverb is a CPU efficient plate style reverb based on the work of Jon Dattorro...
content:
Datverb is a CPU efficient plate style reverb based on the work of Jon Dattorro as detailed in his paper, Effect Design: Reverb and Other Filters. 

The patch operates on a single external that was developed in the gen~ environment and wrapped into an Organelle external with the gen~_ext application by samesimilar.

It is fairly light as it is low level DSP code and could probably be wrapped into other modules wishing to incorporate a plate reverb. Let me know how you all like the sound of it and if you would like me to release the gen~ dsp code that I wrote for it!
